$description: Design tokens. Canonical machine-readable source of brand values — mirror of tokens.css and the rules spelled out in references/brand-guidelines.md. Use this file as the entry point when importing the system into Claude Design or any other design tool.

blue.usage: Headlines (accent), stat numbers, overlines, CTAs, accents, icon stroke, progress bar, borders

blueDark.usage: Closing slide background only — never elsewhere

black.usage: Headline + body text when explicit black required

bgLightBlue.usage: Info cards, emphasis cards, tag backgrounds

white.usage: Slide backgrounds, card fills, text on dark

textGrey.usage: Body text — never use black for body

subtitleGrey.usage: Subtitles + secondary headlines ONLY. Inline hex, no CSS variable. Never use --text-grey for subtitles

viewport.usage: Viewport background behind the scaled slide

overline.usage: Small uppercase label on --blue footer cards

rules: Light mode only. White or --bg-grey slide backgrounds. Only exception: closing slide uses --blue-dark.
Blue is the hero. Carries all accent duty.
No semantic colour: never green, orange, or red for status or meaning.
Solid --blue panel backgrounds: reserved for genuine binary contrast. Never decoration.
Never use raw hex in style attributes except #808080 (subtitle) and #000000 (explicit black).

light.usage: Headlines + stat numbers — never bold a headline

semibold.usage: Overlines, badges, card titles, CTA buttons

heroHeadline.notes: Light weight is a deliberate brand choice for elegance

overline.notes: Uppercase, letter-spacing 0.12em. Format: CATEGORY · descriptor. Use rarely

statNumber.notes: Per brand guide. Some templates use clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px) — both valid

rules: Sentence case for headlines and titles — only first word and proper nouns capitalised.
Never bold mid-sentence — bold is for headings and labels only.
Body text is always --text-grey, never black.
All text elements must have contenteditable="true".

scaling.value: CSS scale() transform — renders at 1280×720, scales to viewport

bottom.notes: NON-NEGOTIABLE — clearance for logo + nav chrome. Never reduce.

logo.rule: Use the exact SVG verbatim. Never regenerate, recreate, or approximate the logo.

rules: Place CDN script immediately before </body>, never in <head>.
Target svg in CSS, not i — createIcons() replaces <i> with <svg>.

contenteditable.hover: outline: 1px dashed var(--border); border-radius: 2px; cursor: text
